Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Ben Duckett and Zak Crawley to open for England. Sajid Khan to bowl first.
FOURTH INNINGS...

The pitch is turning and there is something in for the pacers too, Pakistan will hope they can get a couple of wickets before Stumps. England's first aim will be to head into Day 4 without the loss of any wicket. Stay tuned for the chase.

Pakistan managed to forge small, small partnerships throughout their innings. Most of their batters got off to starts but none went onto make it into something significant. At one time, they were in a spot of bother 156 for 8. Salman though counter attacked, he got up a fine half ton and took his side's lead to close to 300.

So England manage to keep Pakistan's lead below the 300-run mark. Saying that, it's still going to be a tough challenge for them. Had they hung onto their chances, the target could have been a lot more lesser than what it is and it won't come as a surprise if those runs added by Agha Salman after the chances he got could be the difference.

England could have been in a lot better position at the end of this session had they held onto their chances but for now, it is Pakistan who'll feel slightly ahead in the game. The visitors though did do well, especially the pacers. They bowled their heart out, created chances too but they weren't taken. The lead is just over 200 and England will hope they can take some quick wickets after the break and put Pakistan under pressure.

Earlier in the session, England relied on Jamie Smith to cut the deficit out but he fell soon in the day to Ali. However, England did got some handy runs from Jack Leach who attempted sweep and reverse sweep very well. His contribution helped England trail by just 75 runs. They came out with spin from both ends and got enough turn to grab three Pakistan wickets. Right then! An eventful first session. It is only going to get worse for Pakistan who have to show a lot of character as we feel England will keep the spin trio in attack for yet another session.

Saim Ayub just doesn't want to leave the crease, he nicks right before Lunch and that means the game hangs in perfect balance with Pakistan stretching their lead to 118 runs but with the loss of three wickets. Shoaib Bashir takes all the wickets. He delivered perfectly throughout the session from one end while Ben Stokes rotated Leach and Root from the other side. Pakistan will be gutted by the loss of Ayub but they still have a healthy lead going into the break.
